# Scope: province. Fill free building slots the way the AI would, then
# take every building to the top of its chain.
one_trait_max_buildings_in_province = {
	while = {
		count = 10
		if = {
			limit = { has_free_building_slot = yes }
			generate_building = yes
		}
	}
	one_trait_upgrade_all_the_way_in_province = yes
}
